title: SessionNotification
description: Params of an ACP v1 `session/update` notification (JSON-RPC notification; no response). ACP v1 SessionNotification shape: `{sessionId, update}`, where `update` is a SessionUpdate discriminated-union object. reviewmesh emits progress as the `agent_message_chunk` variant (a text content block) and preserves its sanitized audit-event detail (no secrets, no raw provider metadata) under the sanctioned `update._meta.reviewmesh` extension. Emitted by the ACP surface during session/prompt; the ReviewManager is unaware of ACP.

sessionId.description: The ACP session this progress belongs to.

update.description: An ACP v1 SessionUpdate, keyed by the `sessionUpdate` discriminator. reviewmesh always emits a `content` text block for its `agent_message_chunk` progress.

sessionUpdate.description: The SessionUpdate variant discriminator. reviewmesh progress uses `agent_message_chunk` (the least-misleading official variant for textual progress).

content.description: An ACP ContentBlock; reviewmesh uses a text block carrying the progress message.

text.description: The progress message for display. Carries a trailing newline so a host that concatenates streamed chunks renders each line separately; the clean (newline-free) message is under _meta.reviewmesh.message.

_meta.description: ACP-reserved extension point. reviewmesh audit-event detail lives under `reviewmesh`.

eventType.description: The audit event type (e.g. run_started, adapter_call_started, run_completed).

timestamp.description: RFC3339 event time (may be empty for synchronous surface events such as mode_degraded).
